title: 第29章 路执事
content_zh:
随着王管事的叱喝声音传遍灵田处所在，一个个杂役弟子走出石屋、灵田，向着紫衣执事、王管事等人所在位置聚拢。

    紫衣执事也并不落下，脚踏花朵法器，凌空而立，目光如鹰隼般锐利，扫过众弟子。

    两名内门弟子在他身后斜下方，王管事等外门弟子则是主动降落芭蕉叶，在内门弟子的斜下方。

    这一排队列，如斜向上方的锥形，以紫衣执事为最高顶点，地位高低之分展露无遗。

    片刻之后，杂役弟子们聚集完毕，紫衣执事开口问道。

    “灵田处杂役弟子，现有多少人未到？”

    王管事连忙对照名单，一一看去，之后迅速汇报：“包括张山在内，今日共有五人未到。”

    “张山、刘兰两人住处，我亲自搜寻，其余未到四人，你们去搜寻，有人先抓人过来询问，若是无人便问明白下落，等人回来也要仔细辨别询问。”

    紫衣执事吩咐一声，从天空降落，王管事神色紧张，在前为他引路，走入张山石屋之中仔细查看。

    紫衣执事板着脸，目光一扫，便盯住了张山石床位置。

    石床已经被倒过来，床板背面铭刻着一个兽头咆哮的纹路。

    床底的位置则有一个水缸粗的黑黝黝的大洞，散发着腥臭之气。

    “养偷灵鼠，顶多算是违反门规，但这驯兽御兽的独家纹路，可是灵兽宗的。”

    紫衣执事冷然说道。

    “这个张山，必然是灵兽宗收买的。”

    王管事连声附和：“路执事说的对极了，必然如此！张山是五灵根资质，又入门二十年，灵兽宗绝无可能从一开始便用他来布局，只能是最近几年通过青禾坊市把他收买的。”

    紫衣执事对王管事的附和并不放在心上，又问：“你是为何察觉这个张山有问题，过来搜查的？”

    王管事低声道：“弟子一开始也并未察觉，只感觉张山离开灵田处不知好歹，准备上报执事房，交给外门弟子追踪处置这私下离开的人。”

    “却没想到此人居然把修炼资源交给非亲非故的刘兰，然后又匆匆一走了之，此举大为违逆修行常理，因此立刻感觉不对。”

    紫衣执事背负双手：“不错，你在灵田处作威作福，倒也没把你的脑子全都用到胯下去。”

    “修行之路上唯有父母供养子女一种可能，从无子女供养父母的时候，连夫妻道侣都得明算账。他灵田处一个二十年的老杂役，修行艰难到这般地步，凭什么要供给非亲非故之人？”

    王管事一脸震惊，额头上冷汗涔涔，嘴唇哆嗦起来。
content_en:
As Steward Wang's scolding voice spread throughout the spiritual field, the handyman disciples walked out of the stone house and spiritual field one by one and gathered towards where Purple-clothed Deacon, Steward Wang and others were.

The purple-robed deacon did not fall behind. He stood in the air with a flower magical weapon on his feet, and his eyes were as sharp as an eagle, sweeping over the disciples.

Two inner disciples were diagonally below him, while Manager Wang and other outer disciples took the initiative to land on banana leaves, diagonally below the inner disciples.

This queue is like a cone-shaped diagonal upwards, with the purple-robed deacon as the highest point, and the distinction between high and low status is fully exposed.

After a while, the servant disciples gathered together, and the purple-clothed deacon asked.

"How many of the handyman disciples from the Lingtian Department have not arrived yet?"

Manager Wang quickly checked the list, looked at them one by one, and then quickly reported: "Including Zhang Shan, there are five people who have not arrived today."

"I will personally search the residences of Zhang Shan and Liu Lan. You can search for the remaining four people who are not here. If there is anyone, arrest them first and ask them. If there is no one, ask for their whereabouts. When they come back, you must carefully identify and ask them."

The purple-clothed deacon gave an order and descended from the sky. Steward Wang looked nervous and led him into the Zhangshan stone house to take a closer look.

The purple-robed deacon had a straight face and glanced at the position of Zhangshan's stone bed.

The stone bed has been turned upside down, and the back of the bed has a pattern of a roaring animal head engraved on it.

There was a large, dark hole as big as a water tank at the bottom of the bed, exuding a fishy smell.

"Raising spirit-stealing rats is at best a violation of the sect's rules, but the unique patterns for taming and controlling beasts belong to the Spirit Beast Sect."

The purple-robed deacon said coldly.

"This Zhang Shan must have been bribed by the Spiritual Beast Sect."

Manager Wang repeatedly echoed: "Deacon Lu is absolutely right, it must be so! Zhang Shan has the Five Spiritual Root qualifications and has been in the business for twenty years. It is absolutely impossible for the Spiritual Beast Sect to use him for its layout from the beginning. He can only be bribed through Qinghefang City in recent years."

Deacon Ziyi didn't take it seriously to Manager Wang's agreement, and asked: "Why did you realize there was something wrong with Zhang Shan and come here to search?"

Steward Wang said in a low voice: "The disciple didn't notice it at first. He just felt that Zhang Shan left the spiritual field without knowing what was going on. He was going to report it to the deacon's room and leave it to the outer disciples to track down and deal with the person who left privately."

"But I didn't expect that this person would actually hand over the cultivation resources to Liu Lan, who was neither a relative nor an acquaintance, and then leave in a hurry. This move greatly violated the common practice of cultivation, so I immediately felt something was wrong."

The purple-clothed deacon put his hands behind his back: "Yes, you are domineering in the spiritual field, but you are not using all your brains."

"On the road of spiritual practice, it is only possible for parents to support their children. When there are no children to support their parents, even husband and wife have to settle their accounts. He is an old handyman who has been living in the spiritual field for 20 years. His spiritual practice is so difficult. Why should he provide for someone who is not a relative or an acquaintance?"

Manager Wang looked shocked, with cold sweat on his forehead and trembling lips.
